plugins.name: interaction-design
plugins.description: The interaction-design role on contract v3: turns the accepted problem (governing hypothesis/product-record) into screen/flow/wireframe specs concrete enough to build from. Directive carries the four facets — same-job exemplar research, governing-record survey, spec proposal, and a quality bar (complete states, heuristic + accessibility floors, every element traced to a recorded need). Spec only, never implementation; loop_state reviewed is this role's terminal record state. PRODUCES points to the eleven id-* methodology plugins below — see each plugin's own directive for phase-specific steps/criteria/prohibitions.

plugins.name: id-proposal-shape
plugins.description: Six-section phase-1 proposal shape (problem/goal, comparison set, methodology cited, delivery scope, adopt/skip, judged-by), each its own heading with real content. Phase 1. Part of the phase-1 proposal norm: id-proposal-shape ∧ id-citation-format ∧ id-stage-order (issue-21 gate-machine proposal §4).

plugins.name: id-citation-format
plugins.description: Evidence citation format for phase-1 proposals: every factual claim about an exemplar or external convention is sourced or labeled an established-practice assumption. Phase 1. Part of the phase-1 proposal norm alongside id-proposal-shape and id-stage-order (issue-21 §4).

plugins.name: id-persona-goal
plugins.description: Cooper goal-directed-design persona/goal reference in the phase-2 record — a named persona with a distinct goal field, not a role label. Phase 2. Ships a checklist (agents/persona-goal-checklist.md) for judging genuineness. Part of the phase-2 judgment norm (issue-21 §4).

plugins.name: id-task-flow
plugins.description: Distinct task/interaction-flow artifact in the phase-2 record, separate from any wireframe-headed section. Phase 2. Part of the phase-2 judgment norm (issue-21 §4).

plugins.name: id-state-completeness
plugins.description: Complete state set (default/empty/error/loading) named per screen/flow in the phase-2 record. Phase 2. Part of the phase-2 judgment norm (issue-21 §4).

plugins.name: id-wireframe-staging
plugins.description: Low-fidelity-before-high-fidelity wireframe staging in the phase-2 record — two distinct staged sub-headings, lo-fi ordered before hi-fi. Phase 2. Part of the phase-2 judgment norm (issue-21 §4).

plugins.name: id-nielsen-heuristics
plugins.description: Full ten-item Nielsen usability-heuristics pass in the phase-2 record, each item carrying an explicit verdict. Phase 2. Ships a checklist (agents/nielsen-checklist.md) for judging genuineness vs rubber-stamping. Part of the phase-2 judgment norm (issue-21 §4).

plugins.name: id-accessibility-floor
plugins.description: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility floor named explicitly in the phase-2 record, with concrete keyboard/focus/label/contrast coverage. Phase 2. Part of the phase-2 judgment norm (issue-21 §4).

plugins.name: id-usability-test-plan
plugins.description: Usability-test plan (task scenario + participant/recruitment count) in the phase-2 record — planned, never conducted or reported by this role. Phase 2. Part of the phase-2 judgment norm (issue-21 §4).

plugins.name: id-traceability
plugins.description: Traceability/scope-growth flagging and the spec-only output boundary, named explicitly in the phase-2 record. Phase 2. Part of the phase-2 judgment norm (issue-21 §4).

plugins.name: id-stage-order
plugins.description: Cross-cutting survey → scout → proposal → record ordering, enforced purely by on-disk artifact presence (never GitHub/network — core's approval-gate.sh already owns the human-Approve precondition). Owns the shared docs/issue-<n>/reports/interaction-design/.status.json contract every other id-* plugin writes its own key into. Composes into both the phase-1 and phase-2 norms (issue-21 §4).
